thesis: A reading-control layer in front of the agent cuts token use sharply while preserving task quality, without touching the agent model.
rationale: The two panels make the caption's tension visible in one glance: the same page, read in full versus read sparsely, with the 92.9% figure as the proof that reading less does not cost the answer.
title: A Layer That *Reads* Less
subhead: Sparse reading cut agent token use by up to 92.9%

insight_cards.caption: Up to 92.9% fewer tokens across six models
Quality preserved or improved in 97% of settings
Agent model untouched, only the interface

layout_wishes: direction left_to_right, spacing airy, finish glow
